name: Beef Porcupines
description: Baked meatballs with rice, served in a tangy tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, mustard, chili powder, salt, allspice, brown sugar, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and paprika. Form into balls.
Place meatballs in a baking dish.
Combine tomato soup and hot water to make the sauce. Pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Britt's Favourite Meatballs
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe with a sweet and tangy sauce, baked in the oven.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup quick cook oats or bran

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 8 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.
Shape the mixture into 1 inch balls and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for 18 to 20 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink.
Combine sauce ingredients and pour over the meatballs.
Return to the oven for an additional 10 to 15 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, baked, sweet and tangy sauce

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty meatball dish smothered in a rich sweet and sour pineapple sauce, baked to perfection.
recipeIngredient: For the sauce: ½ cup brown sugar, ½ cup vinegar, 19 oz pineapple tidbits (undrained), ½ tsp salt, 1 Tbsp cornstarch

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together ground beef, onion, cracker crumbs, garlic, pepper, egg, and milk. Chill until firm.
Shape into evenly sized meatballs and place on a greased broiler pan.
Broil to brown on all sides, watching carefully.
Place meatballs in a casserole dish.
To make the sauce, combine brown sugar, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soya sauce. Add pineapple tidbits and bring to a boil until thickened and clear.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and bake in the oven at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour meatballs, baked meatballs, pineapple sauce

_similar.name: Beef & Barley Soup
_similar.description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef barley soup, hearty soup, freezer-friendly
